resources.string: Ka whakaae ki ngā taupānga hoa kua hainatia ki te kī ōrite kia pānui i ngā raraunga inenga hauora mai i a Bios.
Ka whakaae ki ngā taupānga hoa kua hainatia ki te kī ōrite kia tuhi i ngā tohu kua tātaihia (te manawataki patopato, te wāhanga mataaho-rā, te piro rerekē) ki a Bios.
Nā te tangata kotahi a Bios i hanga, ā, he kore utu, kāore he pānui hokohoko, kāore he aroturuki, kāore hoki he taumata utu. Mēnā i whai hua koe, anei ngā huarahi e toru hei āwhina kia haere tonu ai.
